title: Emergent Object Binding Has a Finite Spatial Horizon
abstract: arXiv:2610.00006v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pretrained Vision Transformers encode whether two image patches belong to the same object. This IsSameObject signal is decodable from frozen patch embeddings at high accuracy, which suggests that object binding emerges from self-supervised pretraining alone. We show that this single accuracy number hides the structure of the signal. Binding is local: the probability that two patches of the same object are decoded as bound falls off monotonically with the distance between them and levels off at a nonzero floor, a falloff well described by an exponential with a finite length scale. This decay holds across object sizes, across three families of probe, on both ADE20K and COCO, and across DINO and CLIP backbones, which indicates that it is a property of the representation rather than of the decoder. Reading binding as local spatial coherence with a finite range accounts for a set of behaviors that the aggregate score leaves unexplained: bin

translated_title: 涌现的物体绑定具有有限的空间范围
translated_abstract: 预训练的视觉Transformer（Vision Transformer）能够编码两个图像块是否属于同一物体。这种“是否同一物体”（IsSameObject）信号可以从冻结的图像块嵌入中以很高的准确率被解码出来，这表明物体绑定（object binding）可以仅通过自监督预训练而涌现。我们发现，这个单一的准确率数字掩盖了信号背后的结构。绑定是局部的：属于同一物体的两个图像块被解码为相互绑定的概率会随它们之间距离的增大而单调衰减，并最终稳定在一个非零的下限上，这一衰减过程可以用具有有限长度尺度的指数函数很好地刻画。该衰减现象在不同的物体尺寸、三种探测探针、ADE20K和COCO两个数据集、以及DINO和CLIP两种骨干网络上均成立，这表明它是表征本身的固有属性，而非解码器的产物。将绑定理解为一种具有有限作用范围的局部空间一致性，可以解释聚合准确率分数所无法解释的一系列行为……
tldr: 该论文发现自监督预训练视觉Transformer中涌现的物体绑定信号具有空间局部性——同一物体两个图像块的绑定概率随距离呈指数衰减并趋于非零下限，表明物体绑定是表征内在的、具有有限空间范围的局部空间一致性属性。
en_tdlr: The paper reveals that emergent object binding in self-supervised pretrained Vision Transformers is spatially local—binding probability for same-object patches decays exponentially with distance toward a nonzero floor—showing that object binding is an intrinsic property of the representation with a finite spatial horizon.
